                                             We construct the most comprehensive evaluation of web API            functions by generating many random inputs to a test function.
                                         fuzzers to date, running eight fuzzers against sixteen real-world        PBT generally differs from fuzzing more in workflow and the affor-

                                         tools we evaluated, Schemathesis was the only one to handle more         shrinking). The definitive PBT library for Python is Hypothesis

and relatively simple constraints on HTTP services, such as:                            formance and known HTTP status codes, with further properties
      • 200 OK responses must have a non-empty body                                     specifiable by the user.

        header listing supported methods                                                negative testing, using the property that nonconforming requests

      • GET fails after successful DELETE (use-after-free rule) [4]                        RESTler [3, 4] is a security testing tool in the tradition of greybox
      • GET fails after unsuccessful POST (resource-leak rule) [4]                      fuzzing, which infers dependencies between request types, gener-
